quote: The City Traffic Engineer is authorized to determine and designate streets, or specific lanes thereon upon which vehicular traffic shall proceed in one direction during one period and the opposite direction during another period of the day, and may also erect signs temporarily designating lanes to be used by traffic moving in any particular direction, regardless of the centerline of the roadway. It shall be unlawful for any person to operate any vehicle in violation of such markings, signs, barriers, or other devices so placed in accordance with this Section.

activation.condition: A City Traffic Engineer designation places a direction device for a street or specific lane during a period, including temporary signs or other listed devices.

obligation.description: A person operating a vehicle shall not violate markings, signs, barriers or other devices placed in accordance with this Section.

timing.description: The effective direction depends on the original civil-time period; preserve every joined frame of lane occupancy and device state.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: The City Traffic Engineer is authorized to determine and designate streets, or specific lanes thereon
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original municipal authorization and exact lane designation must be reviewed; a synthetic device source cannot establish authority.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: during one period and the opposite direction during another period of the day
judgment_calls_needed.note: Retain the original civil-time source and period-indexed designation; do not infer a schedule from the case name.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: regardless of the centerline of the roadway
judgment_calls_needed.note: Keep the original centerline observation separate from the temporary device direction when present.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: in violation of such markings, signs, barriers, or other devices so placed in accordance with this Section
judgment_calls_needed.note: Preserve original indication, vehicle trajectory and full camera views; legal violation is unresolved.
